title: camat review page spec
description: Spec of camat-review-page (camat.review_page), version 1. Paths are relative to the spec's folder. The build checks more than this schema: that files exist, card ids are unique, the bars are in the MEI with an xml:id, and the MEI can be read at before_ref.

$schema.description: URL or path of this schema, for editors; the build ignores it.

description.description: HTML under the heading, inserted as written.

storage_key.description: Key of this review's marks and notes in the browser's storage. Give each review its own.

before_ref.description: Git ref of the 'before' column (git show REF:path). null: no before column.

verovio.description: Verovio options over camat.review_page.VEROVIO_OPTIONS (the web edition's, with scale 50 and no header).

crop.description: How each bar's facsimile zone is cut.

padding.description: Graphic pixels added left, top, right and bottom.

size.description: IIIF size of each crop, also applied to local images.

id.description: Unique; the card's anchor and storage key.

label.description: Heading, and the name in the summary. Default: id.

measures.description: Bars by @n ("12" or "12-14"), or [first, last] with @n values or #xml:ids.

images.description: Further images under the columns, such as a second witness.

rows.description: One row per bar, each with its own marks and a list of the events that changed.

width.description: Verovio page width. Default: 1000 for one bar, 1800 for more, 900 for each row.
